prompt: create a website for depressed dogs to get help from specialists
summary: A whimsical static website for 'depressed dogs' seeking help from canine mental health specialists. This is a lighthearted directory/brochure site listing specialists, their bios, and approaches, plus a light-up-your-day resource section. Since all content (specialist profiles, articles, contact info) is fixed and doesn't require accounts, transactions, or data that changes post-deploy, a single static_site is sufficient — no backend or database needed.

services.name: gloomy-tails-wellness
services.buildCommand: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.html specialists.html symptoms.html success-stories.html resources.html contact.html css js assets dist/
